ops.body: Root-caused; premise inverted. The f08 signal gate PASSES deterministically (writeup is ONE entry scoring S2+S3=3 >= threshold 3; per-entry semantics correct) — pinned by tests/test_wall_of_text_f08.py (hermetic, signals inlined; commit f6497619, ships in 8.5.0). The no-verdict was downstream, cwd-dependent: (1) untrusted/non-git cwd -> spawnllm codex backend refused ('Not inside a trusted directory'), llm_evaluate's fail-safe swallowed it -> every review-backend llm_nudge/llm_gate silently no-opped there; fixed by spawnllm 0.5.5 (--skip-git-repo-check), made load-bearing via floor bump in 8.5.0 (commit 2d03e15b); re-verified live: non-git cwd now returns a real verdict. (2) trusted cwd -> legitimate fire=False from the small model on the borderline 509-char writeup; user ruled it a miss -> show-pack prompt tuning (fire=true example for design-writeup-inviting-feedback) in flight in the show repo. f05 verified live: passes the gate (second message self-scores 4), so cross-entry aggregation has no live failing case; per-entry semantics documented and unchanged, split-message limitation pinned as a constructed test case.
